main_body: Tall brick townhouse with a slate mansard roof, a flat roof top with a chimney, a dormer, an orange cornice, three floors of windows, a balcony and a green door
top_band: Rows 17-22 (6 rows): a lighter grey-green flat roof top (L about 95-122) under the dark outline at row 16. Row 23 is a lighter edge line (L=122), row 24 is a dark eave shadow (L=53), and the slate roof slope then runs down to the cornice at row 44.
evidence: The roof is drawn as a top surface: a lighter flat top (rows 17-22), a front-edge highlight (row 23) and an eave shadow (row 24). Below that, the sloped slate mansard (rows 25-43) and the dormer read as roof surface, and the orange cornice at row 44 closes it. The brick wall below has inset windows with frames and sills, a balcony and a recessed door. No receding side face is drawn. The contract accepts roofs that show their top slopes, so the building passes as three_quarter.

style.evidence: Texture and density are good: 14 colours per tile against 11-18 for the references, 2% flat fill, and per-brick, slate and window detail, with 5 or more shading steps on the brick and the slate. The weak point is the outline. 97% of the dark edge pixels are neutral (#1d1722 around the silhouette and roof), against 7-9% for the references, whose outlines are tinted dark material tones. That gives the sticker-like near-black outline the standard rejects. The candidate also has only 47 distinct colours against 185 and 66 for the references. When in doubt, fail.
